title: Indian Market News Brief — 25 Oct 2026 — Nifty 50
quick_read: Strong quarterly profits from selected banks and cable makers may support market mood. However, sharp profit drops in real estate firms and mixed earnings among top IT companies could keep gains in check. Upcoming major stock listings and regulatory steps to improve trading rules create an active backdrop for investors.

stories.headline: Reliance Jio IPO listing on Oct 28: Will Mukesh Ambani's firm be in top 5 m-cap? RIL to hold top spot
stories.summary:
Reliance Jio Platforms completed its initial public offering which was subscribed 22.19 times.
Shares are expected to be allotted on October 26 and listed on October 28.
Based on its offer price band, the company's market value is estimated at 10.30 lakh crore rupees.
This valuation could place it among the top five largest companies listed on the BSE.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Strong demand for a massive new stock listing could boost general investor confidence across the market.

stories.headline: IT stocks Q2 results analysis: Infosys vs TCS vs Wipro vs HCL vs TechM: Who wins profit, revenue, dividend, AI race?
stories.summary:
Major Indian IT companies showed different performance trends for the September quarter.
Tech Mahindra led in profit and sales growth rates, while HCLTech improved its business outlook.
TCS won the most deal contracts and led in artificial intelligence business scale.
Infosys declared the largest interim dividend, while Wipro posted the weakest profit growth.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Uneven financial results across big technology firms mean stock price movements in the IT sector may be mixed.

stories.headline: AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to Rs 858 crore
stories.summary:
AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% increase in net profit to 858 crore rupees for the September quarter.
Its gross bad loan ratio fell to 1.99% from earlier levels.
Money set aside for unpaid loans dropped 25% to 359 crore rupees.
Net bad loan ratio improved to 0.81% while total credit costs reduced over the year.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Higher profits and lower unpaid loans may encourage buying in private bank shares.

stories.headline: Godrej Properties Q2 profit plunges 62% to ₹154 crore, real estate stock down 6.5% in 1 week - What next for investors
stories.summary:
Godrej Properties reported a 62% yearly decline in net profit to 154.15 crore rupees for the September quarter.
Company shares dropped over 4% following the earnings release.
Rising construction costs and reduced profit margins were highlighted as main concerns.
stories.impact: May hurt Nifty: Lower profits in major property developers could weaken buyer interest in real estate stocks.

stories.headline: SEBI plans Demat 2.0, graded compliance for brokers
stories.summary:
SEBI plans to launch a updated system named Demat 2.0 for market participants.
The plan includes allowing digital corporate bonds to be traded on secondary markets.
The regulator also proposes step-by-step compliance rules for stockbrokers.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Easier trading tools and modernized market rules may increase overall trading activity over time.

stories.headline: Big action! Who is Avadhut Sathe? Why SEBI ordered Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546 cr - What he did?
stories.summary:
SEBI ordered Avadhut Sathe and his academy to refund 546.17 crore rupees to clients.
The entity must also pay 67.87 crore rupees in interest and 11.5 crore rupees in penalties.
The action was taken because the firm gave investment advice without official registration.
All refunds must be completed within five months.
stories.impact: Little effect on Nifty: Strict penalty on unregistered stock advisors protects retail traders but does not directly change main company profits.

stories.headline: Crisil shareholders alerts! ₹17 per share dividend, record date announced in Q2 results; stock gained 7% in 2 weeks
stories.summary:
Crisil reported a 20.2% increase in quarterly revenue to 1,095.16 crore rupees.
The company approved a third interim dividend of 17 rupees per share.
Shareholders on record as of October 29 will receive the dividend by November 17, 2026.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Higher revenue and regular cash payouts to shareholders could support demand for financial service stocks.

stories.headline: Cables and wires stock turned multibagger with 318% return in 5 years; InCred sees 29% upside - Do you own? Target price
stories.summary:
KEI Industries released its financial results for the September quarter.
Quarterly revenue increased by 39% compared to last year.
Operating profit grew by 40% and net profit rose nearly 29%.
stories.impact: May help Nifty: Healthy sales growth in electrical cable makers points to active infrastructure work and supports capital goods shares.

stories.headline: ​ऐतिहासिक उपलब्धि: पीएम मोदी का संकल्प हुआ साकार, 11 करोड़ किसानों को मिला फार्मर आईडी का सुरक्षा कवच
stories.summary:
The Central Government has created digital Farmer ID cards for 11 crore farmers.
The initiative aims to provide direct access to government benefit schemes.
stories.impact: Unclear for Nifty: Better identification of farmers helps rural welfare programs, but immediate impact on corporate stock earnings is limited.
